findings.title: External reference corpus dominates graph centrality
findings.evidence: Top central nodes are heavily from 참고 Context external repos, masking project-local architecture signal.
findings.recommended_action: Run a scoped graph for src/docs/tests only, or maintain separate graphs for external references.

findings.title: UI integration hub is over-connected
findings.evidence: src/ui/app.py appears among top connected nodes with wide cross-domain coupling.
findings.recommended_action: Split app.py into loader/render/ops modules with explicit interfaces.

findings.title: Contract docs are weakly represented in graph
findings.evidence: execution_state_contract.md and cancel_reconcile_loop_contract.md not surfaced as expected cluster nodes.
findings.recommended_action: Add graph-indexed metadata in contract docs and generate explicit links from code/report artifacts.

findings.title: Safety flow semantics are fragmented
findings.evidence: UNKNOWN/kill-switch/reconciliation-critical appear partially as concepts but not as strong canonical graph nodes.
findings.recommended_action: Create a canonical safety taxonomy file and reference it from runtime and audit modules.

findings.title: Task/report lineage underrepresented
findings.evidence: Task identifiers (083/084/093/094) were not consistently discoverable as graph entities.
findings.recommended_action: Introduce a machine-readable task lineage registry linking scripts, reports, and contracts.
